movelist.name: Slam
movelist.effect: Slam may be used as a Free Action at the end of a Sprint Maneuver taken as a Standard Action, as long as the user Shifted at least 3 meters in a straight line towards the target. When used this way, Slam gains the Smite keyword.

movelist.name: Discharge
movelist.effect: Discharge Paralyzes all legal targets on 15+.

movelist.name: Double Team
movelist.effect: The user gains 3 activations of Double Team. The user may either activate Double Team when being targeted by an attack to increase their Evasion by +2 against that attack; or when making an attack to increase their Accuracy by +2 for that attack.

movelist.name: Feint
movelist.effect: If a foe uses a Move with the Shield Keyword in response to one of your actions, you may activate Feint to cause the triggering Move to Fail. Feint is activated as a Free Action.

abilities.name: Motor Drive
abilities.effect: The user is immune to the damage and effects of Electric Type attacks. Whenever an Electric Type attack hits the Pokémon, raise their Speed by +1 Combat Stage. Defensive.

abilities.name: Static
abilities.trigger: The user is hit by a Melee Attack

abilities.name: Sequence
abilities.trigger: The user uses an Electric Attack
abilities.effect: For every Electric-Type Pokémon adjacent to the user, the triggering Attack deals an additional +3 Damage.
